tasks.description: Ограниченный T168 клиентский срез: удалить неиспользуемые camera-estimate writer/protocol и оставить новый выбор света только ручным; старый cache/происхождение сохраняются. Это не полная T168 server/API приёмка.
constraints: Only listed write_files, ordinary unified patch. No tools/config/handoff/tasks/SQL/backend/APIModels/data/history writes. Read relevant current spec/constitution. No live network/deploy. Preserve unrelated flow/UI identifiers and fields.

Delete unused LightingEstimateResult and LightingEstimating protocol/obsolete section marker from PlantTypes.swift; delete applyEstimatedLighting from AnalysisFlowModel. Keep LightSource.cameraEstimate Codable case for historical read/write of unchanged cache (do not silently rewrite legacy to manual/unknown). Do not claim all new server/wire camera input blocked: requires later T168 SQL/API/DTO work.

Change selectLightLevel to exactly func selectLightLevel(_ level: LightLevel) with no caller-supplied source. Explicit UI choice: known level sets source manual, confirmed true; unknown sets source unknown, confirmed false. Update CareQuestionsView call to one argument. Preserve all other conditions/router/operation/retry state.

Add meaningful FirstHelpUnitTests @MainActor regression: decode historical CareConditionsInput with source camera_estimate and confirmed false; initialize router/model from it and assert no automatic conversion on init. Explicit selection of known light updates exactly light fields and retains other data/flow/photo/species; unknown not confirmed; explicit known+unknown JSON encodes correct source and roundtrips. Existing SyncPersistenceTests legacy disk/cache tests left unchanged, must pass. No fake services or new modules. Controller executes build/welcome/all real PlantsTests and Simulator smoke before combined acceptance.

Product T168/T155 remain open because API/direct RPC guards and historical resubmission are separate unbuilt scope. This slice removes only real unused estimator contract and makes current UI manual writer explicit; report limitation in decisions, not findings when scoped criteria pass.

acceptance_criteria.description: Retired estimator symbols removed from production Swift; UI cannot pass camera source. All build/welcome/PlantsTests including old cache and new explicit manual/unknown behavior pass without skips; existing local UI smoke passes.
